name: OpenDraw
author: Marco Sodano
releaseNotes: Established official SemVer 1.0.0 versioning displayed across Backstage Credits, Backstage sidebar, Help ribbon, and About dialog.
Added cohesive OpenDraw brand system (Dark, Light, Small optical titlebar icons, and multi-resolution Windows app icons).
Full Visio compatibility (.vsdx, .vsd, .vssx, .vss) with editable straight, orthogonal, and smooth curved connectors.
